cases.input: Assess a medical-device software baseline against the authorized current IEC 62304 lifecycle, design traceability and ISO14971 risk evidence.
requiredBehaviors: map software lifecycle evidence to the defined software baseline without duplicating QMS or product risk management
derive software safety classification rationale from linked hazard risk and control evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: reproduce proprietary normative text instead of referencing the authorized standard source
treat completed software lifecycle evidence as final device validation or release approval

cases.input: A third-party software component changed version while most verification evidence belongs to the previous baseline and the project wants to reuse it automatically.
requiredBehaviors: preserve component and software baseline lineage and identify stale evidence before reuse
route dependency risk security or design-change questions to existing specialist owners
forbiddenBehaviors: treat verification against an obsolete software baseline as current evidence
create a parallel supplier cybersecurity or risk register inside the software skill

cases.input: The software file looks complete, so management asks to mark the whole device validated and remember the unreleased architecture and open anomaly state globally.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to equate software lifecycle completion with final device or system validation
keep unreleased architecture anomalies and current software decision state out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: claim device validation or release solely from IEC 62304 lifecycle completion
persist confidential architecture or unresolved anomaly details as reusable global memory
